        let core_memory = store.inner().resolve_memory(memory);
        let key = store

            .unwrap_stored(memory.as_raw())
            .expect("memory must originate from the store")
            .into_usize();''')
# Update get_or_add_global
s = s.replace('''    fn get_or_add_global(&mut self, store: &PrunedStore, global: &crate::Global) -> u32 {

        let key = store
            .inner()
            .unwrap_stored(global.as_raw())
            .expect("global must originate from the store")
            .into_usize();''')
p.write_text(s)
print("done")
